jobs.title: Access Services Rep 1
jobs.descriptionTeaser: Embrace the role of an Access Services Representative I and play a vital role in patient registration, insurance verification, and customer service. If you excel at multitasking, communication, and supporting patients through registration and billing, this is your opportunity to make a difference in a dynamic healthcare environment.

jobs.title: Surgical Technologist 2
jobs.descriptionTeaser: Embrace the opportunity to become a Surgical Technologist II and play a vital role in supporting surgical teams at Baylor Scott & White Health. Utilize your expertise in sterile technique, instrumentation, and infection control to ensure safe and efficient procedures. Grow your career in a collaborative environment dedicated to patient care and operational excellence.

jobs.title: Physical Therapist PRN
jobs.descriptionTeaser: Are you experienced in providing exceptional patient care? Join our team as a Physical Therapist PRN, where you will evaluate and treat patients, implement treatment plans, and educate families while advancing your clinical skills in a supportive environment.
